<style>

        /* New Warm & Elegant Theme Colors */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #f4f1ee; /* Warm Off-White */
            --text-color: #5a5349; /* Warm Gray/Brown Body Text */
            --heading-color: #4a433a; /* Darker Warm Gray/Brown Headings */
            --accent-color: #8b8173; /* Muted Khaki/Taupe Accent */
            --font-serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
            --font-sans: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;

            /* Existing non-color variables kept for structure */
            --shadow-subtle: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --border-radius: 12px;
        }

        /* General Styles */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .container {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-serif);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-top: 0;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        p {
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        b, strong {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        section {
            padding: 60px 0;
        }
        
        /* --- Hero Section --- */
        .hero-section {
            background-image: url('/img/bbb4.avif'); 
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center center;
            position: relative; 
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 400px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            padding: 80px 20px 60px;
            border-bottom-left-radius: 40px;
            border-bottom-right-radius: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .hero-section::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        
        .hero-section .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .hero-section h1 {
            font-size: clamp(30px, 5.5vw, 54px);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            text-shadow: none;
        }

        /* --- Content & Philosophy --- */
        .content-wrap {
            padding: 40px 0;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .intro-text, .philosophy-box {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .intro-text h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .philosophy-box {
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .philosophy-box h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .philosophy-box p {
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .philosophy-box p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        /* --- Services Grid --- */
        .services-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .service-card.full-width,
        .service-card:nth-child(3),
        .service-card:nth-child(4) {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }
        .service-card {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }
        .service-card h3 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .service-card p {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .service-card p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
        .service-card ul {
            padding-left: 20px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }
        .service-card li {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }

        /* --- Why Choose Us --- */
        .why-choose-us {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .why-choose-us h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .why-choose-intro {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .why-choose-intro p {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .reason-list {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .reason-list li {
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent-color);
            font-size: 15px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
        }
        .reason-list strong {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message {
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            text-decoration: underline;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* --- FAQ Section --- */
        .faq-section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .faq-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .faq-list {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .faq-item {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .faq-q {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .faq-a {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text-color);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin: 0;
        }

        /* Learn More Button */
        .learn-more-wrap {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 35px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 14px 38px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.3);
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn:hover {
            background-color: var(--heading-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(74, 67, 58, 0.4);
        }

        /* --- Closing Section --- */
        .closing-section {
            padding: 40px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .closing-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .closing-section p {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto 15px;
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .closing-section p a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* --- Work Done / Project Showcase Gallery Carousel --- */
        .work-gallery-section {
            margin-top: 50px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gallery-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 35px;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }
        .gallery-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .gallery-header p {
            font-size: 16px;
            max-width: 750px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            padding: 15px 0 25px;
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-track {
            display: flex;
            width: max-content;
            animation: infiniteGalleryScroll 30s linear infinite;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:hover .gallery-carousel-track,
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:active .gallery-carousel-track {
            animation-play-state: paused;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
            padding-right: 25px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card {
            width: 320px;
            max-width: 340px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.2);
            transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            height: 240px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background-color: #e5e0d8;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform 0.6s ease;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover .gallery-img-wrap img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }
        @keyframes infiniteGalleryScroll {
            0% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate3d(-25%, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation: none;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
                overflow-x: auto;
                -webkit-mask-image: none;
                mask-image: none;
            }
        }        /* Mobile Responsiveness */
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .hero-section {
                padding: 60px 16px 40px;
                border-radius: 0;
            }
            .content-wrap.container {
                padding-left: 0;
                padding-right: 0;
                padding-top: 25px;
                padding-bottom: 25px;
            }
            .intro-text {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 35px;
            }
            .intro-text h2 {
                font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6.5vw, 2.1rem);
                line-height: 1.22;
                margin-bottom: 16px;
            }
            .intro-text p {
                font-size: 16px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                margin-bottom: 15px;
            }
            .philosophy-box {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                padding: 26px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                overflow: hidden;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .philosophy-box h2 {
                margin: 0 0 22px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 7vw, 2.25rem);
                line-height: 1.18;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
            }
            .philosophy-box p {
                width: 100%;
                margin: 0 0 20px;
                padding: 0;
                text-align: left;
                text-indent: 0;
                font-size: 17px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: normal;
                hyphens: none;
            }
            .philosophy-box p:last-child {
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 20px;
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }
            .gallery-card {
                width: 280px;
            }
            .gallery-img-wrap {
                height: 200px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-group {
                gap: 18px;
                padding-right: 18px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation-duration: 22s;
            }
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 25px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
            .process-card-row {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) {
            .intro-text,
            .philosophy-box,
            .services-grid,
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section,
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 40px);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <section class="hero-section">
        <div class="container">
            <h1>Modern Interior Design in Delhi</h1>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER -->
    <div class="container content-wrap">

        <!-- INTRO -->
        <div class="intro-text">
            <h2>Modern Interior Design for Simple, Comfortable, and Stylish Spaces</h2>
            <p>Modern interior design is focused on making the space simpler, practical, more comfortable, and aesthetically appealing. <b>Modern Interior Design in Delhi</b> is suitable for those people who are looking for a neat and fresh look for their homes, offices, and commercial places. Contemporary design is characterized by simple forms, functional furniture, good lighting, and the use of colors that contribute to the overall spacious appearance of the designed area.</p>
            <p>The contemporary space does not require many elements in design. Proper choice of furniture, colors, lighting, storage solutions, and décor helps to achieve balance. First, we analyze the dimensions of the space, requirements of the client, lifestyle, preferences, and so on.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- PHILOSOPHY / SERVICE OVERVIEW -->
        <div class="philosophy-box">
            <h2>Simple and Functional Spaces with Modern Interior Design</h2>
            <p>Modern interior designs pay more attention to simplicity and proper usage of the space. Everything that we do not need, we get rid of; we appreciate good planning and functionality in the design.</p>
            <p>Good lighting, large spaces, simple furniture, appropriate color choice – all these factors may enlarge the interior visually. Each element of the design is chosen depending on its function. For clients looking for <b>modern interior design solutions in Delhi</b>, we focus on creating spaces that look fresh while remaining comfortable for everyday use.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- SERVICE CATEGORIES GRID (4 CARDS) -->
        <div class="services-grid">
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Residential Modern Interiors</h3>
                <p>A modern house needs to be comfortable, simple, and easy to manage. We design the modern interiors of apartment houses, family houses, villas, and other residential buildings.</p>
                <p>The living room may be furnished simply with an open plan. The modern kitchen can contain practical storage and neat finishes. The bedroom can be decorated with soft colors and suitable furniture and lighting for a calm atmosphere.</p>
                <p>We plan the wardrobe, study room, dining room, and other parts of the house, depending on the space available.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Commercial Modern Interiors</h3>
                <p>Modern design will also add functionality to the office, showroom, and <b>retail interior space</b>. Our team <b>designs commercial interior spaces</b> which are designed to meet business requirements but have a neat and professional appearance.</p>
                <p>The office interior space may consist of workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, reception area, and common area. The <b>showroom interior space</b> may consist of product display space, movement space, and proper lighting.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card full-width">
                <h3>Key Features of Modern Interior Design</h3>
                <p>Modern interiors include several simple, intentional features that significantly improve the look, feeling, and utility of any space:</p>
                <p><b>Clean Lines & Open Spaces:</b> Layouts that are quite simple and have space make a room look larger. Furniture arrangement is such that easy movement in the room is not obstructed.</p>
                <p><b>Simple Colors:</b> There are many popular choices for modern house coloring, such as white, gray, beige, and some other bright colors. There should be some color accents for a unique effect in the interior.</p>
                <p><b>Smart Furniture:</b> Your modern furniture has to serve the appearance and still has to be functional as well. Use furniture that features storage beds, built-ins, modular units, and multi-purpose furniture in an effort to save space.</p>
                <p><b>Good Lighting:</b> Lighting is an essential part of modern design. The use of a combination of ceiling, wall, and pendant lighting with daylight will help to maintain an ambiance of relax and comfort.</p>
                <p><b>Useful Materials:</b> Wood, glass, metal, tiles, and others may be used, resulting in a smart and contemporary appearance. Materials are chosen according to the design of the room and its needs.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card full-width">
                <h3>Space Planning, 3D Design & Project Execution</h3>
                <p>A good plan leads to better use of space. Storage is designed to accommodate maximum requirements within a defined area, along with partitions, furniture, and other elements based on the room's size and purpose. <b>Modern Interior Design in Delhi</b> focuses on combining practical space planning with clean and functional design.</p>
                <p>3D designs also help clients get a clearer idea of how the finished interior will look. They can visualize furniture, storage, colours, lighting, and other interior elements before the work begins. A discussion is held during the planning stage to understand the client's requirements and preferences, making it easy to review and modify before execution begins.</p>
                <p>Interior design does not end with planning; proper execution is vital. We coordinate selection of materials, bespoke furniture, lighting, and decorations with active on-site supervision. To find the <b>Best Modern Interiors in Delhi</b>, thorough planning and disciplined execution deliver spaces that are both elegant and functional.</p>
